card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS headings and warnings
card.fires_on: Words written in ALL CAPS, usually partway through a long capitalized word or phrase in a heading or warning line. It responds where the next token is likely to be another capitalized word.

modes.label: Split capitalized words
modes.description: Later pieces of a long capitalized word in a heading, such as a drug or place name.
modes.example: REBE<<CCA>> RIOTS, the name given to some

modes.label: Capitalized small words
modes.description: Short capitalized words like OF or SHOULD inside an all-caps heading or instruction.
modes.example: OVERVIEW<< OF>> THE STAGES The National Citizen Service

modes.label: Capitalized medical terms
modes.description: Parts of capitalized medical or drug words in warnings and dosing headings.
modes.example: DO NOT ADMINISTER VIA AN INTRAVEN<<OUS>> PUSH.

card.writes: It promotes capitalized words like THE, IN, DE and FIG, which pushes the model to continue in all caps.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of ALL-CAPS headings and warnings, and helps the text keep going in capitals.
evidence: THE SPOT<< SHOULD>> NOT BE ALLOWED TO DRY.
